fix: Handle cancellation at the calling boundary.
Increase the budget or restore provider responsiveness.
Restore the correct private key or reset the damaged value.
Verify the public key and runtime crypto support.

what: An env file could not be read.
fix: Check the path, file type and access permissions.

what: An env file could not be replaced.
fix: Check disk space and parent-directory permissions.

what: One or more env entries could not be loaded. Public data excludes values and raw causes.
fix: Address each named problem before starting the app.

what: The process environment does not match the schema, so the app must not boot.
fix: Set or correct the variables listed in the report, then start the app again.

what: The runtime could not generate a keypair.

fix: Restore the environment key from its backup.

what: The target file has no public key.
fix: Initialize the file before encrypting values.

what: A secret provider rejected a read.
fix: Check the provider CLI installation, login and reference.

what: Rotation stopped after its recovery keys were saved.
fix: Keep the staged key file and retry rotation.

what: A dotenv value has no lossless quoting.
fix: Use encryption or a value supported by dotenv quoting.
